## 中文

- **原生接入与默认模型路由**：改用 DeepSeek Harness 原生组件、Markdown 渲染与宿主语言同步（中 / 英），并默认跟随 DSH 当前提供方、模型、推理强度与 SDK 流式参数和 Binary 文件直传，取消扫描件原图自动入库与自动发图。
- **全量 JD 岗位语义复评**：按 DSH 模型上下文窗口与输出预留动态分批，长 JD 优先单条完整送评，超限时才按完整段落节选并标注；由模型判断主职责并核验原文引文，移除启发式封顶，证据不足标为「待核实」，统一首页与后台队列（老手录岗不挤占新岗），正文补全/变化后自动复评一次、未变复用。
- **全页 PDF 与混合识别增强**：支持全量提取多页文字 PDF 与扫描件本地 Vision OCR（最高 100 页文字 / 20 页 OCR），逐页识别文字+图像混合 PDF（`pdf-mixed`），页面明确展示实际覆盖页数，部分结果自动保持本地预览并给出可读原文与提示。
- **工程与发布校验**：强化按当前版本动态校验双语发布说明及模拟发布回归，并在三平台 CI 覆盖真实 DSH 全新安装、`0.1.3` 原地升级与简历导入。

## English

- **Native DSH Integration & Model Routing**: Adopted DeepSeek Harness UI primitives, native Markdown rendering, and host locale sync (`zh`/`en`), following DSH's active provider, model, reasoning effort, SDK streaming configuration, and binary file uploads while keeping scanned images local by default.
- **Full-JD Semantic Job Triage**: Dynamically sized LLM batches from each DSH model's context window and output budget, evaluating long JDs solo in full (and excerpting by complete paragraphs only on budget overflow). Models judge primary responsibility with verbatim quote verification, heuristic post-LLM caps are removed, insufficient evidence surfaces as Uncertain, homepage and background selection share one fresh-first queue, and verdicts re-evaluate once when JD text changes.
- **Multi-Page & Mixed PDF Extraction**: Removed 20-page text and 8-page OCR caps (up to 100 text / 20 OCR pages), added per-page mixed text + local Vision OCR (`pdf-mixed`) alongside cross-platform `unpdf` page coverage, and kept partial extractions in local review with clear page coverage and verifiable raw text.
- **Release Hygiene & 3-OS Smoke Coverage**: Added dynamic version-matched bilingual release-note checks, simulated publish tests, and 3-platform CI verification covering fresh install, `0.1.3` in-place upgrades, and document imports.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Nimbus318/dsh-niuma-broker/compare/v0.1.3...v0.1.4
